visual_summary: In a pale, rocky alien landscape filled with strange organic forms and attacking creatures, a silver-haired humanoid with metal claws on both hands is shown first in close-up, then launching himself into combat. A smaller creature speaks about a legend involving 'Magon people,' a 'little no-hair white ape,' and journeys to 'fog world' and 'diamond planet.' The clawed man rejects being fangless by asserting that he has claws, then dives into the swarm, slashing through monsters before confronting a much larger beast.
